notes: Historical discontinued record; this retained status and the historical fees, rewards and benefits are inherited from the existing record, not independently reverified in this provenance-only update. The issuer-submitted CFPB 2018_Q4 archive member "HSBC Bank USA/Premier World Elite MasterCard Cardmember Agreement and Disclosure.pdf" explicitly names this personal product and HSBC Bank USA, N.A. on its 10/2018 agreement cover. Current HSBC Elite product and terms pages establish the current product, not the date or terms of a historical conversion. Removed unsupported 2021-01-01, early-2021 rename and replaced_by claims. Exact application-withdrawal/account-closure dates and successor remain unknown pending a dated issuer notice. Any current-product Source is a comparator, not evidence of a conversion; an archive quarter is not a discontinuation date. Historical artwork provenance (checked 2026-10-21): the retained 2019-06-26 archive of the official HSBC US credit cards comparison page places this image (cc_prem_elite_card_img_542x347.png) directly above the product heading "HSBC Premier World Elite Mastercard® credit card". The linked image resolves to a 2019-05-03 archive capture of the HSBC-hosted asset and was visually inspected as the black HSBC Premier Mastercard with the geometric lion design. It is a 542x347 historical image documenting the product as marketed at that date; it is not evidence of lifecycle, successor or the financial fields, which were not reverified in this artwork-only update.
